changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.schemas WHERE name = N'RedGate') EXEC('CREATE SCHEMA RedGate');

changeSet.author: redgate
changeSet.sql: IF OBJECT_ID(N'Sales.customer_feedback_summary', 'V') IS NOT NULL AND OBJECT_ID(N'RedGate.customer_feedback_summary', 'V') IS NULL BEGIN EXEC('ALTER SCHEMA RedGate TRANSFER Sales.customer_feedback_summary'); END
